arabic: وَ مُصَدِّقُوهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ بِالْغَيْبِ
وَ الِاشْتِيَاقِ إِلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ بِحَقَائِقِ الْإِيمَانِ
فِي كُلِّ دَهْرٍ وَ زَمَانٍ أَرْسَلْتَ فِيهِ رَسُولًا
مِنْ لَدُنْ آدَمَ إِلَى مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
وَ الَّذِينَ أَبْلَوُا الْبَلَاءَ الْحَسَنَ فِي نَصْرِهِ ،
وَ اسْتَجَابُوا لَهُ حَيْثُ أَسْمَعَهُمْ حُجَّةَ رِسَالَاتِهِ .
وَ قَاتَلُوا الْآبَاءَ وَ الْأَبْنَاءَ فِي تَثْبِيتِ نُبُوَّتِهِ ،
وَ مَنْ كَانُوا مُنْطَوِينَ عَلَى مَحَبَّتِهِ
يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَنْ تَبُورَ فِي مَوَدَّتِهِ .
وَ انْتَفَتْ مِنْهُمُ الْقَرَابَاتُ إِذْ سَكَنُوا فِي ظِلِّ قَرَابَتِهِ .
فَلَا تَنْسَ لَهُمُ اللَّهُمَّ مَا تَرَكُوا لَكَ وَ فِيكَ ،
وَ كَانُوا مَعَ رَسُولِكَ دُعَاةً لَكَ إِلَيْكَ .
وَ اشْكُرْهُمْ عَلَى هَجْرِهِمْ فِيكَ دِيَارَ قَوْمِهِمْ ،
وَ خُرُوجِهِمْ مِنْ سَعَةِ الْمَعَاشِ إِلَى ضِيقِهِ ،
وَ مَنْ كَثَّرْتَ فِي إِعْزَازِ دِينِكَ مِنْ مَظْلُومِهِمْ .
اللَّهُمَّ وَ أَوْصِلْ إِلَى التَّابِعِينَ لَهُمْ بِإِحْسَانٍ ،
الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَ لِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
الَّذِينَ قَصَدُوا سَمْتَهُمْ ، وَ تَحَرَّوْا وِجْهَتَهُمْ ،
وَ لَمْ يَخْتَلِجْهُمْ شَكٌّ فِي قَفْوِ آثَارِهِمْ ،
يَتَّفِقُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ، وَ لَا يَتَّهِمُونَهُمْ فِيمَا أَدَّوْا إِلَيْهِمْ .
مِنْ يَوْمِنَا هَذَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
وَ عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَ عَلَى ذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ
وَ تَفْسَحُ لَهُمْ فِي رِيَاضِ جَنَّتِكَ ،
وَ تَمْنَعُهُمْ بِهَا مِنْ كَيْدِ الشَّيْطَانِ ،
وَ تُعِينُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى مَا اسْتَعَانُوكَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ بِرٍّ ،
وَ تَقِيهِمْ طَوَارِقَ اللَّيْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ إِلَّا طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ .
وَ تَبْعَثُهُمْ بِهَا عَلَى اعْتِقَادِ حُسْنِ الرَّجَاءِ لَكَ ،
وَ تَرْكِ التُّهَمَةِ فِيمَا تَحْوِيهِ أَيْدِي الْعِبَادِ
لِتَرُدَّهُمْ إِلَى الرَّغْبَةِ إِلَيْكَ وَ الرَّهْبَةِ مِنْكَ ،
وَ تُهَوِّنَ عَلَيْهِمْ كُلَّ كَرْبٍ يَحِلُّ بِهِمْ
وَ تُعَافِيَهُمْ مِمَّا تَقَعُ بِهِ الْفِتْنَةُ مِنْ مَحْذُورَاتِهَا ،
وَ كَبَّةِ النَّارِ وَ طُولِ الْخُلُودِ فِيهَا
transliteration: Fī kulli dahrin wa zamānin arsalta fīhi rasūlā
Min ladun Ādama ilā Muḥammadin ṣallā-llāhu ‘alayhi wa ālih
Wa-stajābū lahu ḥaythu asma‘ahum ḥujjata risālātih.
Wa qātalū-l-ābā’a wa-l-abnā’a fī tathbīti nubuwwatih,
Yarjūna tijāratan lan tabūra fī mawaddatih.
Wa-ntafat minhumu-l-qarābātu idh sakanū fī ẓilli qarābatih.
Fa-lā tansa lahumu-llāhumma mā tarakū laka wa fīk,
Wa kānū ma‘a rasūlika du‘ātan laka ilayk.
Wa khurūjihim min sa‘ati-l-ma‘āshi ilā ḍīqih,
Wa man kaththarta fī i‘zāzi dīnika min maẓlūmihim.
Allāhumma wa awṣil ilā-t-tābi‘īna lahum bi-iḥsān,
Alladhīna yaqūlūna rabbanā-ghfir lanā wa li-ikhwāninā-lladhīna sabaqūnā bil-īmān
Alladhīna qaṣadū samtahum, wa taḥarraw wajhatahum,
Wa lam yakhtalijhum shakkun fī qafwi āthārihim,
Yattafiqūna ‘alayhim, wa lā yattahimūnahum fīmā addaw ilayhim.
Wa tafsaḥu lahum fī riyāḍi jannatik,
Wa tu‘īnuhum bihā ‘alā mā-sta‘ānūka ‘alayhi min birr,
Wa taqīhim ṭawāriqa-l-layli wa-n-nahāri illā ṭāriqan yaṭruqu bi-khayr.
Wa tuhawwina ‘alayhim kulla karbin yaḥillu bihim
Wa tu‘āfiyahum mimmā taqa‘u bihi-l-fitnatu min maḥdhūrātihā,
translation: O God, and the followers of the messengers,
And their verifiers from the people of the earth in the unseen,
When the obstinate opposed them with denial,
And in yearning for the messengers with the realities of faith.
In every age and time wherein You sent a messenger,
And set up for its people a guide,
From Adam down to Muhammad, may God bless him and his Household,
From the Imams of guidance,
And the leaders of the God-fearing,
Upon all of them be peace.
So remember them from Yourself with forgiveness and good pleasure.
O God, and the Companions of Muhammad specifically,
Those who excelled in companionship,
And those who made a goodly trial in his support,
And responded to him when he made them hear the argument of his messages.
And they left spouses and children
In manifesting his word,
And fought fathers and sons in establishing his prophethood,
And they gained victory through him.
And those who were enfolded in his love,
Hoping for a commerce that would never perish in their affection for him.
And those whom the clans deserted
When they clung to his handhold,
And kinship ties were severed from them when they dwelt in the shadow of his kinship.
So do not forget for them, O God, what they left for You and in You,
And make them pleased with Your good pleasure,
And for how they gathered the creation to You,
And were with Your messenger, callers from You to You.
And thank them for their migration for Your sake from the homes of their people,
And their departure from abundance of livelihood to its straits,
And those of their oppressed ones whom You made numerous in exalting Your religion.
O God, and convey to their followers with excellence,
Those who say, 'Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith,'
Your best reward.
Those who aimed for their path, and sought their direction,
And proceeded in their manner.
No doubt turned them away in their insight,
Nor did any uncertainty agitate them in following their tracks,
And taking guidance from their beacons.
Supporting and aiding them,
They profess their religion,
And are guided by their guidance,
They agree upon them, and do not accuse them in what they conveyed to them.
O God, and bless the Followers (Tabi'in),
From this our day until the Day of Judgment,
And their spouses and their offspring,
And those among them who obey You.
A blessing by which You protect them from disobedience to You,
And You expand for them in the gardens of Your Paradise,
And You prevent them thereby from the guile of Satan,
And You aid them thereby in whatever good they seek Your aid for,
And You protect them from the visitations of night and day, except a visitor who visits with good.
And You incite them thereby to the conviction of good hope in You,
And eagerness for what is with You,
And abandoning suspicion concerning what the hands of the servants possess.
So that You may return them to desire for You and awe of You,
And make them ascetic in the abundance of the immediate world,
And endear to them work for the Hereafter,
And preparation for what is after death.
And make light for them every anguish that befalls them
On the day souls depart from their bodies.
And grant them well-being from the dreaded things of the trial that occurs,
And the onslaught of the Fire and the long abode therein.
And cause them to arrive at a security
From the resting place of the God-fearing.
